channel.title: Docker on Trinidad Marroquin
channel.description: Recent content in Docker on Trinidad Marroquin

item.title: Blue-Green Deployment With NGINX
item.description: Field note for blue-green deployment mechanics using NGINX upstream switching, covering manual and weighted patterns.

item.title: Canary Deployments With HAProxy Weighted Routing
item.description: Field note for canary deployment mechanics using HAProxy weighted backends to control blast radius during rollout.

item.title: Concourse CI/CD On Windows With Terraform
item.description: Project notes for deploying Concourse CI/CD on Windows Docker with Terraform, TLS key management, PowerShell provisioners, and production pipeline patterns.

item.title: Concourse Key Management With Vault Bootstrap
item.description: Field note for bootstrapping Concourse CI/CD keys with HashiCorp Vault using Terraform, covering TSA key architecture and runtime secret retrieval.

item.title: Docker Stale Binaries In Usr Local Bin
item.description: Field note for diagnosing Docker failures caused by stale runc and containerd-shim-runc-v2 binaries in /usr/local/bin shadowing package-managed versions.

item.title: Feature Toggles With Environment Variables
item.description: Field note for using environment variables as feature toggles, including cross-language patterns and the limits of the approach.

item.title: From Local IaC Labs To Production-Ready Patterns
item.description: A practical SRE view of how local Terraform, Docker, Helm, Kafka, and observability labs can become production-ready infrastructure patterns without pretending the lab is production.

item.title: IoT Device Container With Terraform And Certificate Mounts
item.description: Field note for running an AWS IoT device in a Docker container managed by Terraform, focusing on X.509 certificate injection via volume mounts.

item.title: Kafka KRaft Mode In Docker Compose
item.description: Field note for running Kafka in KRaft mode (no Zookeeper) with Docker Compose for local development and testing.

item.title: Kafka Readiness Checks In Terraform Docker Labs
item.description: Field note for local Kafka labs where Terraform creates Docker infrastructure, waits for broker readiness, and then creates topics or starts stream processors.

item.title: Kafka Streams Pipeline With Terraform
item.description: Project notes for building a local Kafka Streams data pipeline managed entirely by Terraform, including broker provisioning, topic creation, and stream processor deployment.

item.title: Local SLI Labs With Prometheus Grafana And cAdvisor
item.description: Field note for using a local Docker and Terraform lab to validate service-level indicators with Prometheus, Grafana, and cAdvisor.
